The declaration's unfolded definitions reproduce those quantities, dependencies, endpoint conventions, norm semantics, and diagonal Lambda A construction exactly, while correctly excluding zero rows. The material difference is that the paper's fmax and Fmax are maxima of Model 1 formats, whereas the theorem ranges over all positive real values.
